stem: Under Article XIV, Section 5 of the 1987 Constitution, which area must the State give the highest budgetary priority?
hints: This rule is in Article XIV, the article on education, science and technology, arts, culture and sports.
Section 5 of Article XIV says the State "shall assign the highest budgetary priority to" one area, then gives a reason about teaching.
Section 5 says this priority should help teaching "attract and retain its rightful share of the best available talents." Pick the area that teaching belongs to.

solution.methodName: Find the provision, then match the key words

steps.action: Find the rule: "The State shall assign the highest budgetary priority to education."
steps.why: Budgetary priority means which area comes first when the government divides its money.

steps.action: Read the purpose: to "ensure that teaching will attract and retain its rightful share of the best available talents through adequate remuneration and other means of job satisfaction and fulfillment."
steps.why: Remuneration means pay. Good pay helps draw and keep good teachers.

steps.action: The State must give education the highest budgetary priority.

trapNotes.National defense: Defense is important, but Article XIV, Section 5 names education for the highest budgetary priority.
trapNotes.Public health: Article XIII, Section 11 gives priority to the health needs of the under-privileged, sick, elderly, disabled, women and children. But the highest budgetary priority goes to education.
trapNotes.Infrastructure: Section 5 does not mention infrastructure. It names education for the highest budgetary priority.
